mapper.select: SELECT T.ID, T.CODE, T.NAME, T.STATUS, T.SORT_NO FROM E_PRINT_TEMPLATE_TYPE T WHERE T.STATUS = 1 ORDER BY T.SORT_NO ASC, T.ID ASC
SELECT T.ID, T.CODE, T.NAME, T.STATUS, T.SORT_NO FROM E_PRINT_TEMPLATE_TYPE T WHERE T.ID = #{id}
SELECT T.ID, T.CODE, T.NAME, T.STATUS, T.SORT_NO FROM E_PRINT_TEMPLATE_TYPE T WHERE T.CODE = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO E_PRINT_TEMPLATE_TYPE ( ID, CODE, NAME, STATUS, SORT_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_E_PRINT_TEMPLATE_TYPE.NEXTVAL, #{code}, #{name}, #{status}, #{sortNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE E_PRINT_TEMPLATE_TYPE SET CODE = #{code}, NAME = #{name}, STATUS = #{status}, SORT_NO = #{sortNo} WHERE ID = #{id}
